chunks: He asked him about a man: is it proper for him to perform salat (prayer) while there are beads and pearls in his mouth? He said: “If it prevents him from his recitation, then no; and if it does not prevent him, then there is no harm.”
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray with beads or pearls in the mouth if they do not affect recitation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning performing salat (prayer) while something is in the mouth. The criterion is whether it interferes with proper recitation: if it obstructs recitation, it is not permitted; if it does not, there is no harm.
